title: 八点整的门铃  (Left at the Landing)

segments.t: Ten minutes before eight, Qing, Mei, and Manager Zhou put the finishing touches on the third-floor room. Every detail counts before the rain-soaked guest arrives. Listen first.
小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
弄好了！蓝地毯放在床旁边正合适。
这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
说实话，今晚我自己都想住这儿了！
等等，换房间我们给他打多少折？
今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
真大方！你们听到楼下大门门铃了吗？
八点整！我们的客人到了！
我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
交给我吧。我们下楼欢迎他。
Now let's go back through the scene, one line at a time.
这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
'Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?' Smooth flat surfaces you look into—mirrors, flags, drums—take
面
literally 'face', as their counting word.
挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
'Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.' Direction pair:
右边
joins 'right' with 'side', matching 'left-side' from Zhou's question.
等等，换房间我们给他打多少折？
'Wait—what discount do we offer him for changing rooms?' Notice how Chinese expresses discounts: 'strike how-much fold', where 'half price' or 'eight fold' names what fraction you pay.
今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
'Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!' Two favourite hotel words:
半价
is 'half-price', and 'exempt-fee' at the end means 'free of charge'.
真大方！你们听到楼下大门门铃了吗？
'How generous! Did you hear the front gate bell downstairs?' Praising someone open-handed uses
大方
literally 'big-square', everyday Mandarin for 'generous'.
八点整！我们的客人到了！
'Eight o'clock sharp! Our guest is here!' Right on the hour, tack
整
onto the clock number: 'eight o'clock whole' means 'eight sharp'.
我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
'My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!' Literally 'heart jumps fast', Zhou describes a racing pulse with plain everyday words.
交给我吧。我们下楼欢迎他。
'Leave it to me. Let's go downstairs and welcome him.' Reassuring promise:
交给我
literally 'hand it over to me', means 'leave it to me!'. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
弄好了！蓝地毯放在床旁边正合适。
这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
说实话，今晚我自己都想住这儿了！
等等，换房间我们给他打多少折？
今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
真大方！你们听到楼下大门门铃了吗？
八点整！我们的客人到了！
我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
交给我吧。我们下楼欢迎他。
The warm brass lamp glows softly right as the eight o'clock guest rings the front gate bell. Next time, Hao steps in out of the rain. See you next time.
再见！
